documents.title: Consequence 2 — smoothing buys only a constant
header: > 2. **Smoothing buys only a constant.**  Best of the tested weights, `(u(1−u))^3`: `|M_φ| = 1.18·10^{−4}` against the sharp `7.07·10^{−2}` — a factor `600`.  The max of `|E|√N` over `N = 10^2 … 10^5` is `7070` (sharp), `490` (`u(1−u)`), `11.8` (`(u(1−u))^3`), `797` (raised cosine), `2614` (`e^{−u}`).
- A consequence of [Theorem 2 (weight law)](tpp-rh044-truths-theorem-2-weight-law.md); `E = S_N^φ − ζ` is the smoothed error.
